title: Example Article: The Template
subtitle: This article is a sample. It shows: this is how an article page is built.
description: This article has no subject topic. It shows the building blocks of an article page: intro, text, definition, example, check, takeaways.

intro.title: This is a placeholder template
intro.text: This page explains no subject topic. It shows you the blueprint for an article. Every part of the page is one building block. Every part explains itself. You can use this page as a template. This is how you write your own article.

structure.title: How an article is built
structure.text: An article has a fixed order. An info box comes first. It tells you: this is what the page is about. Then come short sections with text. Every section has a heading. So you always know where you are. A definition block explains important words. An example box shows one concrete example. At the end there is a check and the takeaways. At the very bottom the article shows related content. For example words from the glossary.

definition.title: Term: article page
definition.analogy: An article page is like a museum. A sign stands at the entrance. It tells you what to expect. Then you walk through the rooms. Each room has one theme. A panel stands at the exit. It sums everything up.
definition.precise: An article page is its own page in the portal. It uses the template app-lesson-template. It has meta data: an id, a title, a reading time. You can reach it with a short address of 4 characters.
definition.example: This page here is such an article page. Its short address is: sda1.

example.title: Example: the short address
example.text: Every article gets a short address with 4 characters. The short address fits well in a book. It also fits in a QR code.
example.label: Short address
example.result: /article/sda1 leads to this article. Try it out.

checkpoint.title: Check: do you know the template?
checkpoint.item1: I can name the building blocks of an article: intro, text, definition, example, check, takeaways, related content.

takeaways.title: Key takeaways
takeaways.text:
1. **An article is its own page**: it uses the template app-lesson-template. Its data lives in its own file.

2. **Fixed building blocks**: text block, definition, example box, and check. So every article looks equally clear.

3. **Everything is connected**: the article shows related words and events automatically. This comes from its data file.

This template has no subject topic. Swap the content. Keep the structure.
